annotations.title: Get a skill and its price

description: Get one skill card (free) plus the exact x402 payment_required body for its one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, and how_to_buy. Price is price_usd on the card. Buying is over HTTP; MCP does not take payments.

slug.description: The skill's slug, as returned by search_skills (for example 'humanize'). An unknown or unlisted slug is an error.

name: get_skill

buy_url.description: HTTP address to buy the file (x402).

category.description: Category slug; null if the skill has no category yet.

category_url.description: Page of the category; null if there is no category.

faq.description: Questions and answers about the skill.

languages.description: Language codes the skill works in, or 'any'.

url.description: Page with the full license text.

mcp_tool.description: Always null: buying is over HTTP, not MCP.

not_for.description: What the skill is not for; null if not stated.

payment.description: Short payment summary: protocol, asset, network and whether selling is open.

selling.description: Whether the shop is open for payments right now.

payment_required.description: The exact body the HTTP shop answers with HTTP 402; the client signs it. Buying is over HTTP.

accepts.description: Payment requirements to sign; sign accepts[0].

price_micro.description: The same price in millionths of a dollar.

price_usd.description: One-time price in US dollars, as a decimal string.

purchases_count.description: Number of purchases; null until there are at least 10.

redownload_url_template.description: HTTP address template of the free re-download; {token} is the receipt token.

related_url.description: API address of the related skills.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, lowercase hex.

size_bytes.description: Size of the SKILL.md file in bytes.

slug.description: Stable identifier of the skill; use it with get_skill.

tested.description: How the skill was tested; null if not recorded.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last update.

version.description: Current semantic version of the SKILL.md file.

title: Get a skill and its price
